title: 외국법자문사법 시행규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:4:2:00006:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 4(2) (Removal of External Members of the Ministry of Justice Disciplinary Committee) The Minister of Justice may remove an external member of the Ministry of Justice Disciplinary Committee if the member meets any of the following conditions:

1. If the member is unable to perform their duties due to mental or physical disability.
2. If the member has engaged in misconduct related to their duties.
3. If the member is deemed unsuitable to serve as a member due to dereliction of duty, damage to their reputation, or other reasons.
4. If the member informs the Ministry of Justice that they find it difficult to perform their duties.
